wotsubject.description: Required when the Descriptor serves as a WoT Subject Descriptor. Additional typed annotations are defined by the applicable profile.

reference.description: Exact local name of the selected TD Reference, whose class is https://xregistry.io/classes/thingdescription.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer string into the ordinary resolved TD. Empty selects the whole Thing; URI-fragment and percent decoding do not apply.
